name: io.scalably/figma-mcp
title: Figma MCP
description: Figma MCP: list frames in a file and fetch one frame's JSON and image safely. 2 tools.

environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Figma personal access token with file_content:read

environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Figma REST API base URL, default https://api.figma.com/v1

environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_MAX_JSON_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Upper bound on a Figma JSON response in bytes, default 104857600

environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_MAX_FRAME_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Upper bound on a downloaded frame PNG in bytes, default 104857600

environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_OUTPUT_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Directory that all fetch_frame output directories must stay below, default ./figma-output

environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_ALLOW_HTTP_FOR_TESTS
environmentVariables.description: Test suite only: set to 1 to allow a plain-HTTP loopback API base. Never set it in normal use
